# src/cuda/core Documentation

*This file is automatically generated by merging README files from multiple branches.*

## From branch: codex/add-readme.md-for-cuda/core-directory-2025-06-22


This directory contains the foundational wrappers used by the rest of the CUDA backend. The classes here abstract the raw CUDA runtime and provide safer C++ interfaces.

## Classes

- **`CudaCore`** – A singleton that manages device initialization, stream creation and kernel launches. It also tracks basic GPU metrics such as memory usage.
- **`CudaWrapper`** – Lower level singleton offering thin wrappers over the CUDA C API. Other modules rely on this instead of calling the runtime directly.
- **`Stream`** – RAII wrapper around `cudaStream_t` with helpers for synchronisation and event handling. The actual implementation details live in `StreamImpl` which is defined in `include/cuda/stream_impl.h`.
- **`KernelTrace`** – Utility struct for timing kernels using CUDA events. It is defined in `core.cu`.
- **`Error`** and **`Status`** – Simple helper types used by the above classes for error reporting.

## Directory structure

Having a separate `core` subdirectory keeps the low level wrappers grouped together. If this separation becomes unnecessary it can be merged back into the parent `cuda` directory without affecting the public headers.
